record.body:
## Problem

Agents need policy for when to record vs bind. Encoding that in aff as modes was rejected; it belongs in orchestra skills and handoff.

## Approach

decide at plan-phase: update orchestra skills (verify-work / execute-phase / discuss cues) so gates and handoffs use trail and bind; aff stays mode-free.

## Exit criteria

decide at plan-phase: skill text names when to record vs bind; a handoff or verify path shows claim → binding → observation; no new aff work-kind modes.

payload.title: Orchestra workflow uses trail and bind
